rf.handednessSwitchingConcept: Per-band DPDT transfer switch selects the source to one of the two RF input ports of a 90-degree quadrature hybrid and transfers a 50-ohm termination to the unselected port.
rf.commonFeedConcept: One moving-side 145/435 MHz diplexer separates the coax feed into the per-band handedness networks; use the reciprocal combining diplexer at the radio end.
rf.antennaRequirement: Independent orthogonal feed ports for each band; existing linear-polarized antenna is incompatible.
rf.connectorStandard: 50-ohm standard-polarity SMA for every RF coax interface; no RP-SMA, BNC, or N-type
rf.rfConnectorStandard: SMA 50 ohm, conventional polarity; no RP-SMA, BNC, or N-type in the RF coax chain
rf.coax: one low-mass service-loop trunk through centered 5 mm shaft bore plus four separately weighed circular-feed coax assemblies (two orthogonal feed branches for each of 145 MHz and 435 MHz); cable types, lengths, connector masses, RF ratings, and bend radii TBD
